placement.xy_basis: J_PI source pad centroid(-13.5,21) aligns with Pi world(-13.5,2). KiCad STEP offset(+100,-100) yields translation(-100,81).
placement.z_basis: 17.5mm provisional lower substrate datum within official Pi pin-tip15.5 plus SLW4.57 housing minus2.16..2.92 insertion =>17.15..17.91. Generic socket STEP is not exact SLW; third-party Pi pins reach17mm.

body_collision_review.method: OCC per-solid volume intersections of real released substrate/component bodies against world-transformed CAD objects; copper/pad/via visual bodies excluded. Nominal glass is an explicit drawing-based negative probe.
limits: Stock KiCad sockets have8.5mm bodies, selected SLW housing4.57mm; socket collisions are proxy observations, not actual SLW qualification.
PCB STEP substrate0.71mm versus finished thickness0.8mm; use finished stack for manufacturing.
Native FPC path/contact/stop not represented by a vendor panel STEP.
body_collision_review.whole_assembly_workbench_note: Two generic socket overlaps; some complex pairs were undetermined within its time budget. Supplementary per-body results cover the listed structural bodies only.

native_tail.proof: After the recommended-region curvature ends by unfolded6mm, the tail must be horizontal to enter a horizontal socket. Before0.8mm its initial13deg tangent drops only0.8*sin13. Even an unphysical perfectly vertical5.2mm bend region adds at most5.2mm drop. Using the entire connector upper surface as the slot gives an intentionally generous ceiling, not a real mating plane. The current minimum7.424mm drop exceeds5.380mm ceiling. Minimum radius, insertion and contact direction can only add constraints. Length allowance does not extend the manufacturer bend zone.
evidence: retained screen transform and PCB17.5mm placement

choices.changes: Allows a raised small horizontal FPC connector board; changes the one rigid PCB requirement.
Retains one rigid PCB but needs different GPIO stack/connector arrangement and likely front module deck accommodation.

native_tail.interpretation: Conservative design check keeping all curvature inside the manufacturer-recommended bend region. This does not prove that bending outside that region is physically impossible or independently qualify such a route.
